breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the exact distributed axial force P(x) = ρ g A (L − x) and integrates it along the bar length, matching the ground truth approach. It explicitly removes the incorrect instruction to replace the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load, instead computing the elongation via the proper integral δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(AE) dx. There is no mention of collapsing the load to a single end force or calling such an approximation 'exact.'
